summary.name: Zeplin
summary.one_liner: Zeplin is a design delivery tool that lets designers document designs, map user flows, and track version changes so developers can build from clear, structured specs outside the design canvas.
use_cases: hand off UI designs to developers
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Zeplin as a tool for design delivery, separate from design tools where designs are created. It says it lets teams document designs, map user flows, and track version changes so developers get a clear, structured view of the final designs. It mentions AI features for reviewing designs and organizing screens for handoff. The page is mostly marketing copy and does not detail specific export formats, integrations, or workflows.
notable: Separates design delivery from the design canvas, giving developers a structured view instead of live design files
Maps user flows and documents designs for handoff
AI features for reviewing designs and organizing screens
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Listed in awesome-mac as freeware, but the page itself does not confirm pricing terms
